Status

See also: Quests

Legend

It is very hard to become a postman so Kevin has a five step course of Assistant Postman, Postman, Grand Postman, Grand Postman for Special Operations, and Arch Postman.

Location

Begins in Kevin's office at the Tibia Postal Service Headquarters, but takes you all over Tibia.

Dangers

This trip has little risk throughout it until the end. Creatures to encounter are goblins or skeletons, Ice Island creatures, dwarves of sorts, trolls or orcs, and all types of minotaurs.

Reward

Cheaper parcels (10 gp), letters (5 gp), boat fares (10 gp cheaper). 6k discount in The Thieves Guild Quest. Use of locked mailboxes, Post Officer's Hat, Post Horn and the achievement Archpostman.

Spoiler • edit

This quest takes a great deal of time and money. It can be worked on at any level but certain parts need 500 oz cap and at the end, the Player needs to be able to make it to and through Mintwallin, which can be done with others help.

This quest can be done in stages, depending upon your abilities or time constraints.

There are a total of 10 missions in five groups: Assistant Postman (cheaper parcels and letters), Postman (Post Officer's Hat), Grand Postman (boat discounts), Grand Postman for Special Operations (Waldo's Post Horn), and Arch Postman (use of royal Mailboxes).

The time required for the missions is approximately (depending on walking speed):

Mission Time Spent
1 15 minutes
2 15 minutes
3 10 minutes
4 20 minutes (including collecting bones)
5 15 minutes
6 1 hour
7 30 minutes
8 10 minutes
9 20 minutes
10 35 minutes
total 3 hours and 50 minutes

Required Equipment

Since there is so much walking on "safe" paths, you should bring plenty of Food. Brown Mushrooms are the best. If you are a mage or paladin, be sure to bring plenty of Blank Runes also.

Assistant Postman

  • Approximately 700 gp. More or less depending upon the routes that you take.
  • Crowbar

Postman

  • 20 Bones (for every player)

Grand Postman

  • 1 Mouldy Cheese, 1 Banana Skin and 1 Dirty Fur (for the whole party)

Grand Postman for Special Operations

  • Approximately 200 gp. Maybe more or less depending on your Dice Rolls.
  • 12 Arrows
  • Grapes

Arch Postman

  • 500 oz of available capacity (500 oz is needed to take the Letterbag out of the box, someone can carry it for you).
  • Travel money to Vega

Note: A Stealth Ring is advisable lower levels attempting last mission.

Method

Start out by talking to Kevin at his post office between Thais and Kazordoon (here (32568, 32022, 7)). Ask him for a mission and tell him you are interested in joining his guild (does not prevent you from joining a "normal" Tibia guild). If you forget where you were going, or if you have completed a mission, you can check the quest log or to Kevin and ask about a mission.

Assistant Postman

Mission 1 - Check Postal Routes

  1. Head to Thais and take the Boat to Carlin (110 gp)
  2. Walk to Femor Hills and carpet to Edron (60 gp). The ramp to get Uzon is located here (32511, 31840, 7) (You can also purchase a crowbar which is needed for next mission, from Beatrice for 260 gp).
  3. Boat to Venore (40 gp)
  4. Walk to Kazordoon and in deepest cave, ride the Steam Boat to Cormaya (160 gp, for the Kazordoon route to the ship, see here) - Alternately go back to Edron, to Cormaya, and boat to Kazordoon and back.
  5. Return to Kevin's Post office (cheapest way is to walk through Rotworm caves to Edron, boat to Venore and walk to Kevin's Post Office)
  6. Tell Kevin you completed the mission.

Mission 2 - Fix Mailbox

  1. Get a Crowbar (can be purchased from Edron, Darashia, Kazordoon, North of Thais (Lubo) and Venore)
  2. Take the ferry to Folda (20 gp) - North-West of Carlin (here (32233, 31677, 7))
  3. Climb to the top of the mountain (here (32001, 31567, 7)) and 'use' the crowbar on the mailbox
  4. Return to Kevin and ask about advancement.

You are now an Assistant Postman! (cheaper parcels and letters)

Postman

Mission 3 - Bill Delivery

  1. Ask Kevin for a new mission and receive a Bill for one Magician Hat and a bunch of rabbits to be delivered to a famous magician. Don't bother skipping to the next step if you don't have the bill in your possession.
  2. Walk to Venore and seek out A Strange Fellow below the Depot (here (32911, 32077, 7))
  3. Talk to him and keep asking about his 'hat' (4 times) until he gives in and takes his 'bill', which is when he says: "Ok, ok, I'll take it. I guess I have no other choice anyways. And now leave me alone in my misery please."
  4. Return to Kevin.

Bring the 20 bones with you now. You'll hand them on the next mission.

Mission 4 - Aggressive Dogs

  1. Kevin will tell you the classic post officer's plight - aggressive dogs. He will also tell you that they are running low on bones in the "Post Officer's Fund".
  2. Get 20 bones (the easiest way is to go to Mount Sternum and kill skeletons).

Note: Bones weigh 9.50oz each, so 20 will weigh 190oz. Make sure you have enough capacity.

  1. Talk to Kevin and tell him that you completed the "mission" and that you brought "all" of the bones. He will take them one at a time if you cannot carry all 20 at once.
  2. Ask about an "advancement".

You are now a Postman! (Post Officer's Hat)

Grand Postman

Mission 5 - Present Delivery

  1. Ask about another mission. Kevin will tell you to deliver a present to Dermot on Fibula.
  2. As directed, open the right blinking door and take the present from the chest. DO NOT OPEN THE PRESENT!! If you try to open it, you will get nothing and the present will disappear, then you will have to either buy another from NPC Black Bert for 16,000gp or get it with another character.
  3. Travel to Fibula to Dermot and give him the present.
  4. Return to Kevin.

Mission 6 - New Uniforms

  1. Travel to Venore and talk to Hugo, here (32955, 32108, 6). He is located upstairs where dresses and other wears are being sold.
  2. Ask Hugo about new 'uniforms' and new 'dress pattern'. He will say that he has no idea where Kevin got it from, and send you back.
  3. Return to Kevin to say 'dress patterns'. He will send you to Talphion in Kazordoon.
  4. Go north to Kazordoon and talk to Talphion the technomancer. In Kazordoon, on the level with the rats, go to the west end of the passage west of the shops. Talphion is down two staircases and North. here (32563, 31896, 12)
  5. Say 'dress patterns' a few times until he understands you. He will send a letter to Kevin.
  6. Go Back to Kevin and ask about 'dress pattern'. He will acknowledge the message from Talphion, and send you to Queen Eloise for the perfect colors.
  7. Go north to Carlin and find Queen Eloise, here (32315, 31755, 7). Say 'Hail Queen' and ask about 'uniforms.' She will send some samples to Kevin.
  8. Return to Kevin and ask about 'dress patterns'.DON´T SAY MISSION He will mention the samples from Queen Eloise, and tell you to figure out what smell dogs hate the most. He says that Noodles, King Tibianus's dog has the best sense of smell.
  9. Gather the Mouldy Cheese, Banana Skin and a Dirty Fur
  10. Go to Thais Castle, and talk to Noodles, the king's dog.
  11. Say "hi", "sniff banana skin", "do you like that?", "hi", "sniff dirty fur", "do you like that?", etc. Continue doing this until Noodles spits. It could happen even with the first sniffed item.
  12. Return to Kevin and mention "dress pattern". He will tell you he is mailing the patterns to Hugo, and ask you to tell Hugo that they are ordering them.
  13. Return again to Hugo, 'dress pattern.' He will insult the patterns, but ultimately agree to making them.
  14. Return to Kevin. Ask about advancement.

You are now a Grand Postman! (This grants you travel discounts on boats)

Grand Postman for Special Operations

Mission 7 - Measurements

  1. Kevin will tell you that Hugo needs the measurements of all of the Post Officers (in any order).
  2. to Edron to Chrystal (above depot, here (33175, 31813, 7)) and ask her 'measurements'
  3. to Carlin to Liane (in depot, here (32332, 31786, 7)) who will request 12 Arrows
  4. to Kazordoon to Lokur (North end of the depot here (32648, 31906, 8)) who refers you to his armorer Kroox, here (32652, 31889, 9)
  5. to Thais to Benjamin (in depot, here (32349, 32220, 7))
  6. to Venore to Dove (downstairs in depot, here (32918, 32076, 7)) who asks for Grapes to trim her figure (she requires one bunch, only)
  7. to Ab'Dendriel to Olrik (southwest of depot here (32672, 31700, 7)) who gambles with you to give his measurements (5gp per roll, bring some gold)
  8. The cheapest way is:
  • Walk to Thais and get the measurements from Benjamin
  • Take the ship to Carlin (100 gps), buy 12 arrows from Perac and get the measurements from Liane
  • Walk to Ab'Dendriel and get the measurements from Olrik (Good luck with the dice)
  • Walk to Kazordoon and talk to Lokur, who will send you to Kroox. Get the measurements from Kroox
  • Use the wagon to go with Gewen on top of Kazordoon, take the carpet to Edron (30 gps) and get the measurements from Chrystal
  • Take the ship to Venore (30 gps) and get the measurements from Dove. She will ask you for Grapes which you can buy from Rodney for 3gps.
  • Walk to Kevin.
9. Report back to Kevin

Mission 8 - Missing Courier

  1. Kevin tells you that the mail courier Waldo is missing, and that you need to find him, or at least his posthorn.
  2. "Where's Waldo?" you ask ... He is in the Thais Troll Caves (here (32489, 32260, 7)). You will need a shovel to open the hole.
  • Once in the caves, go east and down the hole
  • Then go north and east past the Orcs, and up the ladder
  • Waldo will be directly west, behind a sealed door here (32514, 32248, 8). Note: You will not be able to open the door until you have talked to Kevin about Waldo, so do not bother trying to find Waldo before you have received the assignment from Kevin.
  • When you find his dead body, "use" it to get Waldos Posthorn.
Waldo's Posthorn
  • If you don't have the required 500 capacity you need for the next mission, it is a good idea to buy a parcel from Wally and send whatever you do not need to yourself.
3. Go to Kevin with the Post Horn in your possession and ask for advancement

You are now a Grand Postman for Special Operations! (Post Horn)

Arch Postman

Mission 9 - Dear Santa

  1. This time Kevin asks you to deliver some letters to Santa Claus on Vega.
  2. Open the left Sealed Door and get a Letterbag (it weighs 500 oz, and no one else can carry it for you, since it won't come out of the chest unless you have the capacity)
  3. Take this letterbag to Vega by Nielson's raft and go west to Santa's house (here (31955, 31712, 7)).
  4. If you lost the letterbag you can buy a replacement from NPC Black Bert at the price of 8,000 gps.
  5. Use the letterbag on Santa's Mailbox (you cannot use it to send regular mail)
  6. After you deliver the letters, it will become a normal Red Bag.
  7. Return to Kevin for the last mission!

Mission 10 - Mintwallin

  1. Now Kevin gives you a letter to deliver to Markwin here (32420, 32152, 15) in Mintwallin (it's a letter from his mother). A Stealth Ring is advisable for this mission as he summons 4 Minotaur Archers, 2 Minotaur Guards, and 2 Minotaur Mages summoned at once! (And also more on the way to Markwin). He summons his guards only the first time you talk to him.
  2. When you are ready, go to Thais, Ancient Temple, here (32356, 32170, 7) and follow the route here to the Minotaur city of Mintwallin.
  3. Before saying "hi", its highly recommended to cast the invisible spell or the use a of stealth ring. As soon as you say "hi" to Markwin, he will call for his 8 bodyguards. You can also say 'hi' to him from the outside of the castle. This way you can lure a few at a time, or simply ignore them.
  4. Say hi again, and give him his letter.
  5. Return to Kevin and ask about advancement.

Tip: If you don't have stealth rings and are barely above lvl 30, you can push Markwin with furnitue to the right and talk through the level 30 door, no bodyguards will spawn there when you talk to him the first time.

You are now an Arch Postman! (You may now use royal mailboxes).

You will earn the achievement Archpostman.

For a list of royal mailboxes, read the page about Mailboxes.
